title: [3.1.0.3-dev-a] Calibration in BYODA -> BG too close (red triangle) -> LGS (low glucose suspend)
symptom: When doing a calibration in BYODA, a new BG is sent to AAPS close to the last one instead of updating it, causing a 'BG too close' error with a red triangle and the loop falls back to LGS (low glucose suspend).
cause: BYODA sends readings not respecting the 'every 5 minutes' rule, causing duplicate BG readings close together, which leads to incorrect delta calculations affecting algorithm performance.
fix: The issue is mostly resolved except for rare situations; resolving the rest would slow down BG processing too much. Workaround: manually delete the duplicated BG from BYODA tab of AAPS.
evidence_quote: this is already resolved except very rare situations. resolving the rest would mean slowing down BG processing too much
